title: AI-Run Modern LaTeX Manuscript Workflow and Replication Packet
description:
This is the current workflow and replication record for the Modern LaTeX Manuscripts project. It documents the AI-run process used to turn identified scans and born-digital sources into source-reconciled LaTeX working editions, source-frozen translations, evidence packages, and reader-first public releases.

Read first: 00_AI_Run_Modern_LaTeX_Manuscript_Workflow_Current_20260718.pdf. It is the human-facing workflow reader. The Markdown file is its editable source; the two ZIPs preserve the current reproducibility materials and earlier addenda without crowding the public file list.

New in this version: a six-layer authority model; page-unit source rescribing; explicit formula, diagram, and table handling; source-frozen translation units and language-manager gates; immutable completion tests with adversarial self-tests; live-versus-public state separation; reader-first Zenodo packaging with changed-file download/readback and default-preview checks; exact-ref GitHub verification; and continuity requirements for fleet maps and private logbooks.

Status rule: this record documents a method. It does not certify any manuscript, translation, model, or mathematical result. OCR, VLM, formula extraction, crops, inherited TeX, agent output, build logs, and validators have different authority and must not be collapsed into a critical-edition or completion claim.

Corrections and contributions: issues and pull requests are welcome at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: July 18 workflow refresh: frozen source and release gates, pagewise source rescribing, source-frozen multilingual production, language-manager responsibilities, adversarial validator tests, reader-first Zenodo publication, changed-file readback, default-preview verification, exact-ref GitHub checks, and continuity logging. This methodology record certifies no manuscript edition.
